short_description: FED|NEH  SPF Record Modification
description:
Good Morning Gents,

   Per CISA's new requirements our SPF record must be set to be a Hard fail instead of a Soft fail. All that needs to be changed is the "~All" at the end of the record needs to be "-All" instead. IE:

 

v=spf1 ip4:65.114.144.66 ip4:65.114.144.90 ip4:65.196.123.228 ip4:65.196.123.227 ip4:65.196.123.226 ip4:65.196.123.225 ip4:52.222.69.242 ip4:52.222.68.204 ip4:96.127.113.23 ip4:149.72.129.240 include:spf.congressplus.com include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:mail.zendesk.com ~all

 

Should be changed to:

 

v=spf1 ip4:65.114.144.66 ip4:65.114.144.90 ip4:65.196.123.228 ip4:65.196.123.227 ip4:65.196.123.226 ip4:65.196.123.225 ip4:52.222.69.242 ip4:52.222.68.204 ip4:96.127.113.23 ip4:149.72.129.240 include:spf.congressplus.com include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:mail.zendesk.com -all
